Class CreateGameMessage

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.socket.Message.Message
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.socket.Message.messageClient.CreateGameMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CreateGameMessage extends Message
Message sent by the client to request the creation of a new game.

Equivalent to RemoteMethods.createNewGame(nickname, numPlayers, viewId). The player's nickname and view ID are already known to the ClientHandler and are therefore not included in this message.
